pages.title: Deploy service
pages.body: Deploy service releases with the deploy command.

pages.title: Rollback service
pages.body: Rollback service releases with the rollback command.

pages.title: Database backup
pages.body: Create database backups every night with the snapshot command.

pages.title: Database restore
pages.body: Restore database backups with the restore command.

pages.title: Book borrowing
pages.body: Borrow books for fourteen days using a library card.

pages.title: Book renewal
pages.body: Renew books once for seven days if nobody has reserved them.

pages.title: Room booking
pages.body: Book study rooms for two hours at the service desk.

pages.title: Room cancellation
pages.body: Cancel study room reservations at least one hour before the start.

pages.title: Visitor registration
pages.body: Register visitors at reception before arrival and issue a visitor badge.

pages.title: Visitor departure
pages.body: Collect visitor badges at reception on departure.

pages.title: Expense submission
pages.body: Submit expense receipts within thirty days using the expense form.

pages.title: Expense approval
pages.body: Managers approve expense forms within five working days.
